symptom: `describe microflow PrePopulateData.ASU_CheckForWorkforce` / `GenAICommons.ToolCall_ProcessAndExecuteTool` (Evora) prints every guarded activity as `on error without rollback begin end error;` and the handler body they share (log + end; four activities rejoining the main path) is GONE. Parses, checks and re-execs `Unchanged` (splice verdict) — re-executed into a fresh model it deletes the handler
cause: Two or more error flows land on one merge that no normal path reaches. collectErrorHandlerStatementSpans stops at the first merge and emits `join <label>` only if it has one; labelRejoinMerges labels only merges the NORMAL path also reaches, so this merge had no name and every handler block came out empty
insight: Treat the shared handler merge as a CROSSED merge: each block ends `join sharedN;` and the body is printed once in its own section after the main flow — no new syntax, the builder already accepts `join` in a handler to a later section. Narrow on purpose: >=2 distinct guarded activities, merge not normal-reachable. Found only by the rebuild comparison (assertDescriptionRebuildsGraph) run over every Evora flow; `mxcli check` passed the lossy text. Guard `TestDescribeSharedErrorHandler_PrintedOnceAndJoined`, repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/describe-irreducible-shared-error-handler.mdl`
